name: Unyielding Feelings
unlocks: Idyia passage (after Beasts Blocking the Path Home)

meals.note: Fianna at Support 3: her seat goes to an army pair. Sirocco at Support 3: Meal 1 goes to an army pair too.

missables.text: Deliver the Sealed Letter for one quest only: pick For the Empire's Safety
missables.lose: The other quest and its follow-ups

options.gives: Specialty License and 200 Renown (Daniel, Temple Row); Flamma Smugglers in Ch 10
A longer chain (Port) that ends in the Haze Badge (Ch 11)

detail: Most of the roster takes exams, so the License is the practical pick; the 200 Renown helps the Renown 8 push.

missables.text: Stockpile 8 Insect Pearls now if you're on the pearl chain: its last step is due 9/16
missables.lose: Even More Fabled Insect Pearls (Ch 9): 10,000G and 2 Thunderstone

note.text: Cai, Guzran, Tialla and Ultand stay put until Advanced opens at Renown 8 (Ch 10)
detail: Sirocco joins in Ch 10 or later already in a Specialty class: no License for him now.
Bench (Majide, Nydine, Mikaela): no exams in Part I.

buy.text: Buy 2× [[item:Ji]] (3,000G) at the Port of Pandora Armory, Castalia: Seteth now, Jasmine by Ch 12
detail: Their Part II spear unless you find a Silver Spear. Ji needs Spear B.

buy.text: Orens Armory, Idyia: a [[item:Da Mina Bow]] for Mikaela and a [[item:Tempest Bow]] for Peppe later
Start collecting Da Mina weapons from ports: Its Name Is Da Mina (Ch 10) wants 2 for 20,000G

assign.why: Read it at once: Mire Β, her range-3 Insight tag

prep.text: Missed a Renown 6 recruit in Ch 7? Seteth, Ninae and Nydine's rows are there
Keep gifting Sirocco and Fianna toward Support 3: they join from Ch 10 (Sirocco late Ch 10 or Ch 11)

route.note: Castor, Renown 7 (usually late Ch 8): Cai needs Caladrius for his Ch 10 exam
detail: Get the 2 Angelica at Starbirth Garden or Messalina Orchards in Saveilon.
Not Renown 7 by 9/1? Do it in Ch 9, with the Theater and Headsman's Rock.

route.note: Opens the passage to Idyia: one Wild Pegasus and the Orens Armory
Hand in the 30 crops you planted in Ch 7

sub.note: Theater bulletin at Renown 7 (first playthrough only)

explore.text: Catch a Wild Pegasus (two spots in Castalia, one in Idyia) for Flying Steed in Ch 11
Catch a Wild Bau at [[place:Bau-Caller's Cape]] for Seteth's Dragoon: roll for Paired Streak
From Renown 7, catch a Black Magonius for Cai at [[place:Headsman's Rock]], east of Saramis
detail: Lure it with bitter fish and roll for Canto.
Not open yet? Ch 12's Mystery of Headman's Rock takes you there.

explore.text: Plant 30 Cocominj, Oda Monja or Jin Ba Jiao for the Ch 10 crop quest
[[place:Cave Behind the Falls]] (Lv 22, Castalia): Archive B for Tialla, Bullion, Pure Water
detail: Run it with your support pairs.

tips.text: Advance slowly and lure the demonic beast where you can surround it; bring armor-piercing weapons
Check the explosives on the map with ZL before you move
Buccar defects on turn 3 and fights on your side for this battle
It ends with an Event Clash: give Cai a [[item:Linking Rock]]
detail: Peter: pack the Hunter's Bow if the demonic beast counts as a beast?
